options: A method of storing data in compressed archives for long-term retention
A method of processing and transmitting data continuously and in real time rather than in batches
A method of copying an entire database once a month
A technique for converting paper documents into digital files
A way of grouping records so they can be processed at scheduled intervals
questions.explanation: Data streaming is a method of processing and transmitting data continuously and in real time rather than in batches.

questions.stem: Which analogy is used to describe data streaming compared with traditional methods?
options: Water moving in a river on a regular basis, compared with water stored once with no more coming in
A library card catalogue compared with a search engine
A single lorry compared with a fleet of vans
A locked safe compared with an open shelf
A printed newspaper compared with a television
questions.explanation: Data streaming is compared to water moving in a river on a regular basis, whereas traditional methods are like a place where water is stored one time with no more coming in.

questions.stem: In the bucket analogy for traditional data handling, what does filling the bucket represent?
options: Streaming data piece by piece as it arrives
Deleting data once it has been analysed
Collecting a bunch of data and then analysing it all at once
Encrypting data before transmission
Sending data to multiple destinations simultaneously
questions.explanation: In traditional methods we collect a bunch of data, like filling a bucket, and then analyse it all at once; streaming instead brings data in piece by piece.

questions.stem: How does data streaming use social media feeds as an example?
options: Posts are stored for a week and then published together
Users must download an archive to see new comments
Comments are only visible after a nightly refresh
New posts, comments and updates are shown in real time as they are posted
Photos are compressed into batches before display
questions.explanation: Social media platforms use data streaming to show new posts, comments and updates in real time, so refreshing a feed instantly shows new photos and comments.

questions.stem: Which example describes data streaming in financial transactions?
options: Account balances are updated only during an overnight batch
Statements are posted to customers once a month
Loan applications are reviewed weekly by a committee
Interest is calculated at the end of each quarter
A credit card purchase is immediately reflected in the account balance
questions.explanation: Banks use data streaming to process and monitor transactions in real time, so a credit card purchase is immediately reflected in the account balance.

questions.stem: How do wearable health monitoring devices illustrate data streaming?
options: A fitness tracker continuously measures heart rate, steps and sleep patterns, updating health stats in real time
A doctor enters test results into a system at the end of each week
Patients fill in a paper questionnaire once a year
A hospital archives old patient records to reduce storage
A pharmacy prints prescription labels in batches
questions.explanation: Wearable devices use data streaming to provide real-time health information, such as a fitness tracker continuously measuring heart rate, steps and sleep patterns.

questions.stem: In traffic monitoring, what do cameras and sensors on roads provide through data streaming?
options: Monthly reports on road maintenance costs
Real-time information about traffic conditions that helps optimise traffic signals
A static map of road layouts
A nightly batch of vehicle registrations
Annual statistics on fuel consumption
questions.explanation: Cameras and sensors on roads continuously provide real-time information about traffic conditions, helping optimise traffic signals.

questions.stem: Why does an online video on YouTube or Netflix start playing almost instantly?
options: Because the whole video was downloaded overnight
Because the video is stored on the viewer's device in advance
Because the data is streamed to the device as you watch
Because videos are compressed into a single batch file
Because the service processes all requests at scheduled intervals
questions.explanation: Services like YouTube or Netflix use data streaming to deliver videos in real time, so the data is streamed to the device as you watch.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT given as an example of data streaming?
options: Weather monitoring with continuous temperature, humidity and wind speed data
Social media feeds showing new posts in real time
Traffic control systems monitoring traffic flow
Payroll calculated and distributed at the end of a pay period
Online video streaming services
questions.explanation: Payroll processed at the end of a pay period is a batch scenario; weather monitoring, social media feeds, traffic monitoring and online video are all data streaming examples.

questions.stem: In which situations is data streaming described as particularly useful?
options: Situations where data is rarely updated
Situations where storage cost is the only concern
Situations where reports are needed once a year
Situations where paper records must be preserved
Situations where real-time insights and quick responses are crucial
questions.explanation: Data streaming allows us to deal with data on the fly, making it particularly useful where real-time insights and quick responses are crucial.
